page.layout: One column of running text. Running head at top, centred over the text, with the page number at the top right. Marginal note at the right, beside the last line of text. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: scientia, qui in peccata sibi familiaria, ad quæ secundum corruptelam naturæ suæ proclives sunt in infinitum relabuntur, licet superficiaria illa pœnitentia & sa-tisfactione Pontificiorum, in remedium infirmitatis suæ, singulis quibus labun-tur vicibus utantur. Restat itaque ut Deo dent gloriam, ab illo protectio-nem adversus peccati incantamenta pe-tentes, qui hoc potest & paratus est cumulatè facere, ultra omnia quæ petimus aut cogitamus, juxta vim suam potenter in iis qui ipsum timent operantem. Si enim nos qui mali sumus, novimus dona bona dare filiis nostris, quantò magis optimus Pater cœlestis, dabit Spiritum suum Sanctum, postulantibus ipsum; qui illos corroborabit, ut induanc[?] novum hominem qui juxta Denm conditus est, in justitia & sanctitate veritatis. Quocirca ne desperabundus de victoria, fluctuet infirmus proselytorum animus, semper ad Dominum apud quem ex ipsa morte est eva-sio, remittat eos minister Evangelii. Invocent Dominum in angustia sua, ille dilatabit gressus eorum sub ipsis, & crura ipsorum a semitis ejus non declinabunt. Discant cum Davide cordi suo dicere;Psal. 62.6.

page.notes: Printed "Denm" in "juxta Denm conditus" is kept as printed; probably "Deum". "induanc" is kept with [?] because the last letter may be a t. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout. Faint marks at the bottom centre (a "c" and a short stroke) are not printed text and are left out. The page number is printed as Roman-style "IZI", read as 121.
